text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-agent-07","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"OER_NiFeCo_screen_round3","campaign_class":"routine_composition_screen","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate before screening"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-0412"},"comment":"standard init, no changes"},{"server":"deposition_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"baseline NiFeCo reference spot, validated sum=100"},{"server":"deposition_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,5,25,0,35,0,0,-10,45,0,0,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"NiFeCo + trace Ce dopant, Mn background-corrected; sum check=100 OK"},{"server":"furnace_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":400,"duration":60,"substrate":"FTO"},"comment":"standard anneal profile per SOP"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-0412","spot":2},"comment":"acquire doped spot"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,5,25,0,35,0,0,-10,45,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"CP at 10 mA/cm2, routine overpotential readout; composition matches deposit record"},{"server":"model_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"source":"P-0412","spots":[1,2]},"comment":"ingest round-3 results into GP surrogate"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,5,25,0,35,0,0,-10,45,0,0,0,0],"duration":2},"comment":"short 2h stability check on lead candidate"}]}
